Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates a well-defined, smooth opacity in the right paratracheal region that does not significantly displace adjacent structures, which is the classic radiographic appearance of a benign bronchogenic cyst. Other options describe locations (posterior, cardiophrenic, anterior) or morphologies (irregular, calcified) that do not match the visual findings or the typical presentation of this specific congenital lesion.
